prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit story illustration by recomposing the final reference. The first references are canonical identity portraits for exactly the named humans; preserve their actual face shape, eye spacing, nose, jaw, complexion, age, hairline and equipment. The following room master is architecture and set-dressing authority ONLY. The final reference is the edit target, not identity authority. Keep clear bold cel shading, restrained charcoal/navy, muted sage green #6BAA8A interfaces and aged brass #A89060, naturally lit warm skin. No neon green cast, orange wash, plants or photorealistic rendering. Maintain adult stylized head-to-body balance, ordinary neck length and shoulder width. Every human has exactly two complete shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains; five digits per hand with correct thumb side, natural grips, neutral wrists, plausible furniture contact. Any pen must be one continuous straight object. Make a candid story moment with expressive faces and task-directed gazes, never a viewer-facing mugshot. Use available space for the primary lesson display, with large high-contrast words and generous margins. All text, boxes and lines share the actual perspective of their physical screen, which faces its operator and remains readable to the viewer. Avoid labels squeezed into thin strips or little screens beneath blank walls. Other screens may be dark. All required facts are below; no invented measurements, code or filler graphics.
Canonical crew: ensign-demir.
Story action: Demir prepares to assemble only the sections that passed review. Expression: Focused anticipation while checking the supplied decisions.
Demir seated at left, using keyboard with two naturally placed hands, facing one large upright physical display occupying the upper right and center. Replace tiny laptop teaching text with large clear rows: Supplied section decisions; Executive Summary: true; Hypotheses: false; Results: true; Report: pending. Keep the status pending, since the learner has not run the assembly. No paper facing the viewer, no unrelated metrics.
cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, slightly stylized proportions, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space beyond the viewports, green #6BAA8A interface glow and rim light, warm brass #A89060 metal trim, cohesive series look, not photorealistic.
